TEXT:
...There has always been someone by my side, 
watching over me.

In the middle of my hectic life, no matter how 
many seasons passed, she was always there for me.

SPEAKER: SPK_KANAKO
TEXT:
It's all thanks to you, Manami-san. Everything, 
everything...

SPEAKER: SPK_MANAMI
TEXT:
Kanako-chan, you really, really tried your best, 
didn't you?

SPEAKER: SPK_MANAMI
TEXT:
I know that better than anyone else, without a 
doubt.

SPEAKER: SPK_MANAMI
TEXT: You are my... life's worth of pride.

SPEAKER: SPK_MANAMI
TEXT: Just one thing, if that's alright...

Manami's face went red and she looked 
embarrassed.

Before long, she gathered her determination and 
stared directly into my eyes.

It was something that is unsuitable for this occasion, 
a confession.

SPEAKER: SPK_MANAMI
TEXT: Thank you for answering me properly.

SPEAKER: SPK_MANAMI
TEXT: You've grown enough so you can answer honestly.

SPEAKER: SPK_KANAKO
TEXT:
You said you weren't a softhearted person! You 
said you were plotting against me...

SPEAKER: SPK_KANAKO
TEXT: Not to hold back... not to lower my guard...
Her way of speaking returned to that of before.
Manami placed a gentle hand on Kanako's head.

SPEAKER: SPK_MANAMI
TEXT: I said it before, didn't I?

SPEAKER: SPK_MANAMI
TEXT: When you let your guard down, I'll make you cry.

SPEAKER: SPK_KANAKO
TEXT: You didn't mean like this! You, idiot...!

Kanako buried her face in Manami's chest and 
sobbed.
